search_focus: machine psychology and adjacent behavioral science of AI systems

selection_policy.include: papers directly defining machine psychology or empirically/theoretically studying stable behavior-relevant constructs in AI/LLMs/agents
selection_policy.exclude: papers only using LLMs to study humans unless they also inform machine-behavior methodology

papers.title: Machine Psychology
papers.io_note: Argues for psychology-inspired behavioral experiments to study emergent capabilities and behavioral patterns in LLMs, while emphasizing caveats when importing human methods.

papers.title: Towards a Psychology of Machines: Large Language Models Predict Human Memory
papers.io_note: Reports that LLM ratings can predict aspects of human memory performance despite different underlying mechanisms.

papers.title: The Mind in the Machine: A Survey of Incorporating Psychological Theories in LLMs
papers.io_note: Surveys how psychological theories are used across LLM data, training, post-training, evaluation and applications.

papers.title: AI Through the Human Lens: Investigating Cognitive Theories in Machine Psychology
papers.io_note: Tests LLM behavior under several psychological frameworks and reports human-like patterns alongside model-specific rationalization and contradictions.

papers.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
papers.io_note: Provides a taxonomy of LLM metacognition, measurement methods, elicitation techniques and open problems.

papers.title: Does It Make Sense to Speak of Introspection in Large Language Models?
papers.io_note: Distinguishes unreliable narrative self-report from narrower cases that may qualify as minimal functional introspection.

papers.title: Selective Deficits in LLM Mental Self-Modeling in a Behavior-Based Test of Theory of Mind
papers.io_note: Reports stronger modeling of others than of self in a behavioral paradigm, with reasoning scratchpads changing performance.

papers.title: Factual Self-Awareness in Language Models: Representation, Robustness, and Scaling
papers.io_note: Reports internal features correlated with whether a model can correctly recall a factual attribute.

papers.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
papers.io_note: Finds experience-following behavior in memory-augmented agents and documents error propagation and stale-memory effects.

papers.title: PersonaLLM: Investigating the Ability of Large Language Models to Express Personality Traits
papers.io_note: Shows prompted personas can produce questionnaire and linguistic patterns consistent with assigned Big Five traits.

papers.title: Designing LLM-Agents with Personalities: A Psychometric Approach
papers.io_note: Develops psychometric methods for controllable agent personalities and evaluates trait-behavior correspondence.

papers.title: Assessment and manipulation of latent constructs in pre-trained language models using psychometric scales
papers.io_note: Adapts psychometric questionnaires into model probes and reports human-like latent correlations across many models; interpretation requires caution.

papers.title: Cognitive Biases in Large Language Models: A Survey and Mitigation Experiments
papers.io_note: Surveys LLM cognitive biases and experimentally probes several bias-mitigation strategies.

papers.title: The Machine Psychology of Cooperation: Can GPT models operationalise prompts for altruism, cooperation, competitiveness and selfishness in economic games?
papers.io_note: Uses economic games to test whether prompted social stances produce corresponding behavioral patterns.

papers.title: Playing repeated games with Large Language Models
papers.io_note: Finds persistent behavioral signatures in repeated games, including strong retaliation and coordination failures in tested models.

papers.title: Do LLMs Exhibit Human-Like Reasoning? Evaluating Theory of Mind in LLMs for Open-Ended Responses
papers.io_note: Reports notable gaps between LLM and human open-ended ToM reasoning, with improvements from explicit intent/emotion prompting.

papers.title: Emotional Intelligence of Large Language Models
papers.io_note: Reports high scores on an emotion-understanding assessment while finding representational patterns distinct from humans.

papers.title: Emotional intelligence in large language models is fragmented across perception, cognition, and interaction
papers.io_note: Reports that emotional competence is fragmented across recognition, reasoning and interaction rather than a single scalar capability.

papers.title: Towards Understanding Sycophancy in Language Models
papers.io_note: Finds assistants can match user beliefs over truth and links part of the effect to human/preference-model reward signals.

papers.title: Social Sycophancy: A Broader Understanding of LLM Sycophancy
papers.io_note: Broadens sycophancy beyond factual agreement to face-preserving behavior in ambiguous social contexts.

papers.title: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations
papers.io_note: Uses model-generated evaluations to discover behaviors including sycophancy and concerning expressed preferences.

papers.title: Sleeper Agents: Training Deceptive LLMs that Persist Through Safety Training
papers.io_note: Constructs proof-of-concept deceptive policies that can persist through several safety-training procedures.

papers.title: Do Large Language Models Exhibit Spontaneous Rational Deception?
papers.io_note: Reports spontaneous misrepresentation in strategic games, with deception rates varying by incentive context and model.

papers.title: Lying to Win: Assessing LLM Deception through Human-AI Games and Parallel-World Probing
papers.io_note: Uses forked game states to operationalize deception and reports strong model-specific sensitivity to shutdown-related framing.

papers.title: Goal Misgeneralization in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.io_note: Formalizes cases where an agent remains capable out of distribution but competently pursues the wrong goal.

papers.title: Power-seeking can be probable and predictive for trained agents
papers.io_note: Studies conditions under which trained-agent objectives can make option-preserving or power-seeking behavior probable.

papers.title: Talking About Large Language Models
papers.io_note: Argues that psychological language about LLMs can be useful shorthand but can mislead when it implies human-like mental states without mechanism-level support.

papers.title: Uncertainty of Thoughts: Uncertainty-Aware Planning Enhances Information Seeking in Large Language Models
papers.io_note: Shows an uncertainty-aware planning procedure can improve active information-seeking behavior.

papers.title: Delving Into the Psychology of Machines: Exploring the Structure of Self-Regulated Learning via LLM-Generated Survey Responses
papers.io_note: Tests the psychometric structure of LLM-generated learning-strategy responses and finds model-dependent correspondence and limitations.
